records.location: Barnes Common and Old Barnes Cemetery, Barnes, southwest London SW13; original source may conflate common with cemetery.
records.description: Splashd describes two related but different areas: Barnes Common generally and the old cemetery after dark. records.original_source_description: A great outdoors place with loads of str8-acting guys. Nice, safe cruising ground. Easy place to work. Use hiding spots off the beaten track. Take your litter w/ you. Cruisiest at the old cemetery itself is only used after dark but action shifts around.

records.name: Finsbury Park
records.location: Finsbury Park, Haringey/Islington/Hackney border, London N4; source mainly refers to Parkland Walk entrance.
records.description: Splashd's 'Finsbury Park' card actually names Parkland Walk, a nearby linear nature reserve also recorded separately as candidate 1071. Identity overlap is a serious duplicate risk; neither archive claim is evidence of recent firsthand activity.
records.original_source_description: Cruisy nature trail called Parkland Walk at Finsbury Park at night. Go in through the manor house gate and turn to your right. You will see the guys lined up just follow them around. Keep cautious as there have been muggings in the past.

records.name: Holland Park Walk
records.location: Holland Park wooded pathways, Ilchester Place/Kensington High Street, Kensington, London W8.
records.description: Splashd references a path behind an unspecified hostel; this could concern a footpath near Holland Park rather than an official park section. Visit London documents normal Holland Park access until 30 minutes before dusk. Hostel/property boundaries must not be crossed.
records.original_source_description: Well lit areas and seedy alleyways. The path behind the hostel-keep away from hostel. plenty of other places. Once you have found someone, best to hide in the bushes. Most action is behind hostel. The entrance is off Kensington High Street.

records.name: Wildwood Road
records.location: Wildwood Road at Hampstead Heath Extension, Hampstead Garden Suburb, London NW11.
records.description: Splashd describes a roadside wooded alleged dogging/cruising corridor. Camden's directory confirms the Heath Extension lies between Wildwood Road and Hampstead Way. No current roadside access rules, specific pin or date-stamped encounters verified.
records.original_source_description: A long stretch of lonely road with parking and dense woodland. Night-time cruising only. This is a known dogging site but gay guys now using the area. Park up and head into bushes and woods. Not appropriate for daytime use.

records.name: Tottenham Cemetery

records.description: Splashd names a cemetery-lake landscape; Friends of Tottenham Cemetery confirm the genuine working cemetery with public opening about 08:00–16:30 in winter. This does not validate its claimed cruising. Tottenham Park Cemetery is a separate similarly named private property.
records.original_source_description: Cruisies between cemetries and along lake towards north west end. Watch out for families on weekends.
